title: Turn an Unclear Feature Request into a Clear Specification
competency: 02. Spec Framing - Clarifying requirements and defining observable acceptance criteria
mission: Use GitHub Spec Kit to turn an unclear feature request into a clear specification, keeping unresolved decisions visible before implementation.
domain: Subscription management with account roles, billing timing, prorated changes, pending requests, asynchronous provider results, and recovery states.
outcome: A source-backed specification and independent review show what is ready to build, what is conditional, and what still needs a product decision.
seededDefects: The product request does not define what subscription management means.
Stakeholder notes conflict on permissions and when changes take effect.
Pending changes, asynchronous failures, retries, and recovery behavior are unresolved.
A coding agent can silently convert guesses into confident-looking requirements.
verificationGates: Actual specify, clarify, and checklist invocations have ordered captures and retained command dependencies.
Clarifications cover authorization, billing, pending requests, recovery, and scope without invented approval.
Requirements trace to decisions; ready and conditional work has observable acceptance criteria.
A fresh agent reviews preserved, committed draft inputs against the repository.
Every finding has a reasoned disposition, and remaining blockers have owners and next steps.
Application source and supplied evidence remain unchanged.
Final verification checks document structure, source citations, draft provenance, and sealed review evidence.
agentWorkflow: Initialize the pinned Spec Kit integration and process constitution.
Invoke specify and capture its native specification.
Invoke clarify and trace real decisions, assumptions, and open questions to FR requirements.
Invoke checklist to generate unchecked requirements-quality items.
Commit and freeze the spec, decision ledger, and checklists; obtain a fresh-agent evaluation.
Revise findings, preserve original assessments, and seal the actual workflow and review evidence.
workingDeliverables: Preserved review inputs and actual author/reviewer sessions
